name: OmniForge Launch Audit
description: Public zero-auth Streamable HTTP MCP server at https://omnipulse-x402.appwrite.network/mcp for pre-launch domain audits. All 5 tools (website security headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS, llms.txt crawler readiness, 78-TLD RDAP availability, and combined launch audit) are keyless and read-only; other stays on review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: All 5 tools are keyless read-only public HTTP/DNS/RDAP inspections that change no state; pass only public domains you intend to audit.
Keep unknown future tools ('other') on Review, or run the MIT-licensed local stdio package from https://github.com/zColdWater/mcp-launch-audit when auditing from pinned local source.
